intro: Technology, telecommunications, and enterprise sectors have been the primary targets in a recent wave of remote-code-execution attacks, with 17 articles published between April 14 and May 18, 2026. The coverage includes 10 critical and 7 high-severity incidents, affecting organisations globally, with particular focus on Europe and North America. Key vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-8836 (CVSS 10), CVE-2026-41265, CVE-2026-45185, CVE-2026-5760, and CVE-2026-6433, each carrying a CVSS score of 9.8. Government and software development sectors have also been impacted.
